select u.*,m.money,v.is_vip as isVip,v.end_time as vipEndTime, (select c.consortia_name from consortia c where c.consortia_id=u.consortia_id) as consortiaName from tb_user u left join user_money m on m.user_id=u.user_id left join user_vip v on v.user_id=u.user_id where 1=1
and (u.user_id=#{search} or u.phone = #{search} or u.user_name =#{search} )
and u.sex=#{sex}
and u.platform=#{platform}
and u.sys_phone=#{sysPhone}
and u.status=#{status}
and (v.is_vip=2 or v.is_vip is null)
and v.is_vip=1
and date_format(u.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')>=date_format(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(u.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')<=date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and u.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.inviter_code=#{inviterCode}
and zhi_rate>0
and u.is_authentication=1
and (u.is_authentication=0 or u.is_authentication is null)
and u.user_id in (select user_id from consortia )
order by u.create_time desc

select sum(money) from pay_details where `state`=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')

and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select * from ( select c.course_id as courseId,sum(o.pay_money) as 'coursemoney' ,count(*) as 'coursenum',any_value(c.title) as 'coursename' from orders o , course c where o.course_id=c.course_id and o.status=1 and o.orders_type=1
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(o.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
group by c.course_id ) a order by a.coursenum desc

SELECT SUM( o.order_number ) AS orderNumber, g.game_name, SUM( o.pay_money ) AS payMoney FROM ( orders o LEFT JOIN order_taking t ON o.order_taking_id = t.id ) LEFT JOIN game g ON g.id = t.game_id WHERE o.state = 1
and date_format("o.create_time",'%y-%M-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%y-%M-%d')

and date_format("o.create_time",'%y-%M-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%y-%M-%d')
GROUP BY g.game_name
